# omada_ip_group (Resource)

Manages an IP/Port group on the Omada Controller. IP groups are used as source or destination in firewall ACL rules for port-based filtering. Controller configuration is supported without an adopted gateway; traffic enforcement requires hardware.



## Controller compatibility

Verified with Software Controller 6.1.0.19. This resource manages IPv4 IP/Port groups (type 1). IPv4 IP-only, IPv6, MAC, domain, port-only (no IP entries), and port-mask groups are outside this resource's scope.

Omada applies one shared port list to the entire group. Each `ip_list` entry must specify the same nonempty `port_list`; use separate groups when IPs need different port sets. Omitting ports or sending different lists is rejected. This corrects the earlier optional/per-entry port description, which the verified controller cannot implement.

Bare IPv4 addresses mean /32. Explicit /32 notation is retained during refresh; import uses bare addresses for /32 entries. Existing group and unchanged-subnet descriptions are preserved during updates. Built-in groups cannot be modified or deleted.

Import with `siteID/groupID`. The ID comes from the controller's `groupId` field. Successful writes are followed by readback; if creation succeeds but readback fails, the returned ID is retained in Terraform state for recovery.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_list` (Attributes List) List of IP address and port combinations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ip_list))
- `name` (String) The name of the IP group.
- `site_id` (String) The ID of the site this resource belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the IP group.
- `type` (Number) The group type. Use 1 for IP/Port group.

<a id="nestedatt--ip_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ip_list`

Required:

- `ip` (String) IP address or CIDR subnet (e.g., '192.168.1.100' or '192.168.1.0/24').

- `port_list` (List of String) Nonempty port numbers or ranges; every IP entry must use the same list because Omada applies ports to the whole group.
